headlines.text: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4% in a 10-2 vote, with two governors dissenting in favor of a hike; markets price ~83% odds of a December hike
October ISM manufacturing PMI rises to 55.5, a 10th straight month of expansion, beating estimates of about 54.5
Dow closes up 0.4% to 51,984 as Nasdaq sheds 1.1% and S&P 500 slips 0.5% on a renewed rotation out of tech and AI-linked names
Micron slides about 4%, dragging Western Digital and SanDisk lower after Kioxia's cautious outlook rattles memory stocks
Marvell agrees to buy Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal, one of tech's largest-ever tie-ups, to build out AI optical networking
Apple reports fiscal Q4 earnings after today's close in new CEO John Ternus's first call, with investors watching iPhone demand and memory costs
Palantir looks to extend its streak to a 10th straight earnings beat when it reports Q3 results after Monday's close
